subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers keep sponsoring this stale external branch as the Cron timeline implementation, or close it and keep the feature on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644 for a fresh current-UI implementation?
rationale: The visual idea has real user value and proof, but the branch now conflicts with the current UI architecture and still has correctness blockers that may be cheaper to replace than repair.

options.title: Require Current-UI Rebase
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or a maintainer moves it onto `ui/src/pages/cron/*`, preserves status compatibility, and fixes scheduler/status/i18n blockers.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Issue
options.body: Close this stale branch and keep the product direction tracked on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644 until a fresh implementation is opened.

options.title: Maintainer Adoption
options.body: A maintainer can extract the useful timeline design into a new branch, but that should be explicit owner work rather than routine ClawSweeper repair.

recommendation.title: Require Current-UI Rebase
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or a maintainer moves it onto `ui/src/pages/cron/*`, preserves status compatibility, and fixes scheduler/status/i18n blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Cron UI and cron service/status commits make steipete the strongest routing owner for the product and rebase decision.
